watchlist.verdict: ARCHIVE — STOPPED OUT Jul 27 @ $5.80, two days BEFORE the Jul 29 AdCom vote. Stop was correctly set at $14, but market gapped down hard at the open pre-AdCom and the STOP (market-on-trigger) order filled at $5.80 — 59% below the stop trigger. Net P&L: -$234.73 (-71.9%).
watchlist.stop_reason: Stop correctly placed at $14.00. Root cause of the $5.80 fill: this was a plain STOP order, not stop-limit — once triggered by the gap-down open it executed as a market order against whatever price was available, and CAPR gapped straight through with no liquidity in between. Confirms stop-losses do not protect against gap risk on binary-catalyst biotech — the mechanism assumes gradual price movement that pre-event gaps don't respect.

watchlist.notes: ARCHIVE. Entered 16 shares @ $20.35 Jul 15. STOPPED OUT Jul 27 2026 13:30 UTC on DARK exchange: GTC STOP order (trigger $14) filled at $5.80 after a gap-down open ahead of the Jul 29 AdCom. Commission $0.93. Net proceeds $91.87. Realized P&L -$234.73 (cost basis incl. commission $326.60). Position never saw the catalyst it was entered for. CONFIRMED LESSON: plain STOP orders become market orders on trigger and offer zero protection against gap risk — in a binary-catalyst name, the whole point of the trade (the gap) is exactly what breaks the stop. This, plus CELC (-26.32) and VERA (-33.28) — both also binary PDUFA/AdCom plays that missed target and closed well below plan — is the direct evidence behind the Jul 27 2026 decision to pause binary-catalyst trading and pivot to daily momentum discovery. See decisions.md.
